items.label: Step-free entrance
items.description: An entrance without steps on the usable approach.

items.label: Accessible toilet
items.description: A toilet with the required accessible space and fittings.

items.label: Working lift
items.description: A lift that is currently available for the relevant route.

items.label: Stairs present
items.description: Stairs on the relevant route or entrance.

items.label: Wide door
items.description: A door with a usable clear opening width.

items.label: Curb ramp
items.description: A usable ramp at the relevant road crossing.

items.label: Path width
items.description: The measured usable width of an access path.

items.label: Accessible stop
items.description: A stop with step-free boarding support.

items.label: Accessible parking or drop-off
items.description: A suitable accessible parking bay or drop-off point.

items.label: Tactile paving
items.description: Tactile guidance supports the approach and entrance.

items.label: Audio directions or announcements
items.description: Audio information supports navigation and important updates.

items.label: High-contrast signage
items.description: Signs use clear contrast and readable visual information.

items.label: Visual alerts and displays
items.description: Important announcements are available through visual alerts or displays.

items.label: Hearing loop
items.description: An assistive listening system is available where needed.

items.label: Clear, predictable signage
items.description: The route and steps to use the service are clearly signposted.

items.label: Seating along the route
items.description: There is somewhere to rest during a visit or while waiting.
